name: User Setup
desc: Creates a new 'ubuntu' user, copies SSH authorized keys from root to 'ubuntu', and enables passwordless sudo for 'ubuntu' (must be run as root).

name: Docker Installer
desc: Checks if Docker is installed; if not, installs it and adds the current user to the 'docker' group.

name: Nginx Installer
desc: Installs nginx, enables and starts the nginx service. Also installs certbot for nginx.

name: Create SSH Key
desc: Creates an SSH key at ~/.ssh/$1, adds it to the SSH agent, and prints the public key.

name: Password-less Sudo Setup
desc: Enables sudo access and password-less sudo access for the provided user.

name: Add SSH Key
desc: Adds the provided SSH public key to the authorized_keys file.

name: Mount SSH-FS
params: Mount Point ( optional, defaults to Remote Folder )
desc: Mounts a remote SSH filesystem using sshfs at the specified mount point. If a user is not specified, it defaults to the current user.

name: Swap Setup
desc: Creates and configures a swap file on Ubuntu. Default swap size is 2GB and swappiness is 10. Swappiness controls how aggressively the kernel swaps memory pages (lower = less swapping).

name: Nginx Proxy Setup
desc: Creates an Nginx configuration for proxying requests to a specified backend server. Supports SSL with Certbot and Cloudflare DNS plugin, and includes optimizations for WebSockets and compression.

name: Certbot Cloudflare SSL
desc: Uses Certbot with Cloudflare DNS plugin to automatically generate SSL certificates for the specified domain. Installs the necessary Cloudflare plugin if not present.

name: Reset Postgres WALL
desc: Resets the Postgres write ahead log by running `pg_resetwal` from a temporary container. Use with caution will drop all pending writes.

name: Git Clone with SSH Key
desc: Clones a Git repository using a specified SSH key from ~/.ssh/. Assumes the key exists and is a valid private SSH key.

name: Setup NFS
desc: Creates an NFS volume with the given name and accessible only from subnet of the server IP. UID and GID of 1001 are used with all_squash
